title: Diagnose drift at rest in the reward v4 full-command-bank policies and add the comparison scripts
summary: In the stop and quiet probes of both full-command-bank reward v4 policies at update 2000, the drifting joints follow their targets: target and joint drift share a sign on 62 of 64 drifting joints, and at least 89 percent of each stop-probe drifting joint's non-DC action power lies below 1 Hz. Lightly loaded feet show brief contact-normal force losses. The scripts that compute the controlled comparison's metrics, verdicts and verification records are pinned to the retained files; they reproduce the reference tracking errors of 0.640 and 0.696 and recompute each probe's load summary from the raw 400 Hz chunks without difference. A Spark queue runs the six 5000-update launches in the packet order.
next: Record the B, J and Y launches with their 2000, 3500 and 5000 evaluations and compute the three hypothesis verdicts per seed.
reason: The record diagnoses retained probes and adds analysis scripts; it changes no capability state and admits no result.
